title: Study group room, library
prompt: Documentary photograph of a small glass-walled group study room in an Australian university library in the afternoon: three students seen from behind and side-on, softly out of focus, gathered at a round timber table with open notebooks and laptops angled away from the camera, a whiteboard on the far wall covered in hand-drawn scatter plots of dots with a straight trend line through them and a few arrows, no writing on the whiteboard, no signage on the glass, soft daylight from a tall window, muted timber and grey tones, shallow depth of field
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
